373.hook: Stevenson thinks out loud about morals, money, and how to live, with all his usual charm.

374.hook: Bierce's tiny fables skewer politicians, saints and swindlers in two paragraphs each, with a smile like a razor.

375.hook: A condemned planter faces hanging on a Civil War bridge, and time bends strangely.

376.hook: A survivor's vivid chronicle of London as the plague of 1665 empties its streets and fills its graves.

377.hook: Brief warm portraits of the women whose writing shaped a young prairie state.

379.hook: Wry sketches of Gilded Age society, its climbers, dandies and hostesses, by an amused insider.

380.hook: A hanging judge and the son who cannot forgive him, in Stevenson's unfinished masterpiece.

381.hook: Stevenson looks back at childhood, college, gardeners, and dogs, and finds his own young face in the well.

382.hook: Stevenson walks his own city in wind and rain, half in love and half exasperated.

383.hook: A mistaken country house, a bashful suitor, and a night of comic confusion.

384.hook: A silent boy in a shabby London lodging guards a secret that could restore a kingdom.

385.hook: Minor league baseball tales of impossible catches, wild redheads and pennant races decided by inches.

386.hook: Playful, wise essays on marriage, friendship, and the terrors of youth.

387.hook: From a clearing above the Pacific, a beloved novelist writes home about planting, weeding, politics and work.

388.hook: A frontier boy raised by a mysterious father crosses the mountains into the making of America.

389.hook: A doctor lifts the veil between worlds with a scalpel, and something walks back through it into London.

390.hook: Twelve centuries of Chinese poetry rendered into English, from Confucius to the wine-loving Li Po.

391.hook: A medieval war epic of loyalty, betrayal, and a doomed rearguard's last stand against overwhelming odds.

392.hook: An epic of the First Crusade, its heroes, battles, and enchantments.

393.hook: Two small children and an old sailor drift from a burning ship to an island where they must grow up entirely alone.

394.hook: In a town run entirely by genteel ladies, everyone is poor, nobody admits it, and small kindnesses quietly carry the day.

395.hook: An allegory of the town of Mansoul, besieged, lost, and fought over by cosmic armies.

396.hook: A jealous king's cruel arena forces an impossible choice between love and death.

397.hook: Milton's paired hymns to mirth and to melancholy, with a masque and an elegy beside them.

398.hook: Cast out of Eden, Adam and Eve endure Satan's relentless torments in a lost apocryphal chronicle.

399.hook: A poor day scholar leaves school for an apprenticeship while his wealthier friend is about to learn that his fortune has gone.

400.hook: Famous women speak for themselves, then the poet turns to love in a modern city.

401.hook: Two friends in San Francisco agree never to fall in love, which is exactly the problem.

402.hook: A sulking boy perched on a backyard fence dreads having to play a silly knight in a pageant that afternoon.

403.hook: A New York heiress meets a rough mining engineer, and follows him to a revolution-shaken tropical republic.

404.hook: The forgotten smiths and toolmakers whose iron quietly built the modern world.

405.hook: The adventurous life and letters of a beloved reporter, told by his brother.

406.hook: Friends including Roosevelt and Tarkington remember a war correspondent who lived like his own adventure heroes.

407.hook: A young New York reporter takes a quiet consular post on a forgotten Pacific island. It does not stay quiet.

408.hook: Fourteen essays that name the color line, weigh a famous leader, walk the cotton country, and end in song.

409.hook: The first published poems by an enslaved African American woman, on faith, virtue, and imagination.

410.hook: Mountain tales of feuds, courtship and rough justice, told in the voice of the Kentucky hills.

411.hook: An exiled king and his charming swindlers plot a restoration nobody believes in.

412.hook: Breezy visits to the homes and habits of the men who built America's great fortunes.

413.hook: Stevenson's ballads of island vengeance, Highland curses and one long night at sea.

414.hook: A rapturous hour in an English hedgerow where every leaf and insect brims with summer life.

415.hook: A Bible salesman with a gift for tongues wanders bandit-ridden Spain and lands in prison for his trouble.

416.hook: In a small Ohio town, lonely souls reach for connection, each carrying a private, half-spoken truth.

417.hook: Luther's German hymns set to their original melodies, with singable English beside them.

418.hook: Luther argues that living faith, not ritual, animates every good deed, in a foundational treatise of the Reformation.

419.hook: One unpronounceable magic word can transform anyone into anything, and a restless boy just found it.

420.hook: An earthquake drops Dorothy, a kitten, and a cab-horse into a glass city deep underground.

421.hook: A boy walks off to claim his inheritance, wakes up at sea, and finds his life tangled with a hunted Highlander's.

422.hook: A wandering scholar-blacksmith mends a chaise, keeps odd company, and takes the open road again.

423.hook: Conan Doyle's tales from the doctor's side of the red lamp, by turns tender, macabre, and wickedly funny.

424.hook: Drumbeats, saints and street preachers: Vachel Lindsay's poems meant to be chanted aloud.

425.hook: Stevenson turns his pen on nine writers and rebels, from Burns to Thoreau, with candor and affection.

426.hook: A well-meaning young man's small mistake spirals into calamity in Stevenson's wry, mischievous tales.

427.hook: When war erupts over a seized fishing boat, a syndicate of businessmen offers to fight it.

428.hook: Eight sly comedies of courtship, where love arrives at the least convenient moment.

429.hook: A private conjuring show goes strangely wrong, opening a dozen sly and surprising tales.

430.hook: A plain typist walks into a great law firm, and a brilliant man's certainties begin to come apart.

431.hook: A penniless, preening actor sets out to charm his way into a fortune among New York's German shopkeepers.

432.hook: An aging American sent to Paris to retrieve a wayward son finds the old world quietly rearranging everything he believed.

433.hook: A rich man's restless daughter comes home and collides with the reformers trying to break her father's grip.

434.hook: A prim spinster rents a country house and lands in the middle of a murder mystery.

435.hook: Houdini exposes the secret methods of fire-eaters, sword-swallowers and strongmen who once passed as miracle-workers.

436.hook: A boy's tangle of homemade wiring summons something far larger than he bargained for.

438.hook: Poems in English and broad Scots: friendship, weather, illness, and gratitude to good doctors.

439.hook: After the Great War's slaughter, Conan Doyle argues the dead are speaking and we should listen.

440.hook: A boy raised on music alone in the mountains must learn to live among ordinary people.

441.hook: Poems Stevenson kept for himself: prayers, love verses and confessions found long after his death.

442.hook: Short, clean lyrics about wanting, losing and remembering, each one over almost before you breathe.

443.hook: An old book hunter fondly confesses a lifetime of romances, every one bound in leather.

444.hook: Proudhon's provocative treatise on the contradictions of economics and the philosophy of misery.

445.hook: A pioneering study of how individuals dissolve into the irrational, powerful psychology of the crowd.

446.hook: A thoughtful study of history's most notorious murderers and what their crimes reveal about us.

447.hook: A girl grows up amid the brutality and squalor of the Bowery slums, hoping for something better.

448.hook: Le Bon dissects why revolutions catch fire and how crowds turn reasonable people into fanatics.

449.hook: Case studies of people who lie extravagantly for no gain at all, from a pioneering Chicago court psychologist.

450.hook: A girl born under a cloud in a small Ohio town refuses to accept the fate assigned her.

451.hook: A young sailor takes his first command and confronts a becalmed ship and its ghosts.

452.hook: A restless young word-lover leaves home for the roads of England, its gypsies, prizefighters and horse fairs.

453.hook: A sharp businesswoman spots a rival's scheme and sets out to beat him to South America.

454.hook: A rowdy German-American blowhard rollicks through parties, politics, and war in cheerfully mangled English.

455.hook: A famous lecturer insists every bruise life deals you is a lesson in the only school that finishes an education.

456.hook: A successful man confides the haunting memory of a green door that opened, just once, onto a garden of impossible peace.

457.hook: A charming father dies leaving nothing, and his sheltered daughter must find out what she is worth.

458.hook: Poems that swing from bright daylight humor to nightmare shadows and back again.

459.hook: A solitary heiress in a Scottish castle begins to notice who else is walking the moor.

460.hook: A man wakes in a London fog planning to end everything, and meets a girl who won't let him.

461.hook: A bachelor of thirty walks out of his quiet house to go looking for the one woman.

462.hook: A snowball in the ear starts a boy's break from a grudging stepmother toward a fortune of his own making.

463.hook: A young recruit dreams of glory, then meets the noise and smoke of his first real battle.

464.hook: Stevenson sails among remote Pacific islands, recording their people, chiefs, and vanishing ways.

465.hook: Three riders finally cross the ridge they had only ever gazed at, into California's unmapped high country.

466.hook: The votaries and victims of the gaming table, from Olympus to the ruinous hells of Regency London.

467.hook: At a dazzling royal court, a virtuous young wife struggles against a love that could destroy her.

468.hook: A model student meets a girl stepping down from a coach and throws away every future he was promised.

469.hook: A French general breaches an island convent hunting the one nun who once broke his heart in Paris.

470.hook: With wit and paradox, Chesterton takes on the age's fashionable thinkers to defend the importance of belief.

471.hook: A forced betrothal, a family curse, and a doomed love on the Scottish coast.

472.hook: A young man returns to his old Southern town, carrying a dangerous secret.

473.hook: Practical advice on telling tales to children, followed by dozens of stories ready to be told aloud.

474.hook: How to hold a roomful of children spellbound, with a treasury of tales to practise on.

475.hook: General Booth's audacious plan to rescue England's poorest from the abyss.

476.hook: A great engineer looks back on a life of workshops, inventions, and the father who shaped his eye.

477.hook: An Italian reformer argues crime is bred by conditions, not cured by punishment.

478.hook: A schoolyard romance grows into a marriage of money and power, and its price.

479.hook: A warmhearted American boy discovers he is heir to an English earldom and a bitter old lord.

481.hook: A quick-witted pickpocket bolts from a crowded station and talks her way into a new life.

482.hook: In a secluded woodland village, loyal Giles loves Grace, whose father has grander plans for her.

483.hook: A small Indiana town's gossiping elders decide who is respectable and who is ruined, until an outcast comes home.

484.hook: A ragged girl with fierce pride builds a livelihood from nothing on the city streets.

485.hook: A wrong turn on a country road sends Dorothy and a shaggy stranger toward the Emerald City.

486.hook: Swept overboard in a storm, Dorothy lands in a fairy country with a talking hen and a clockwork man.

487.hook: Stevenson's wandering years distilled into verse, from open-road vagabond songs to farewells written in the South Seas.

488.hook: Real trials of women accused of poison and fraud, retold from the records.

489.hook: Thirty-one sharp small-town stories, opening with a woman the whole street refuses to forgive.

490.hook: Calamity Jane tells her own story: wagon trains, army scouting, and a girl who out-rode the men.

491.hook: A Russian envoy sails into Spanish California and finds far more than provisions.

492.hook: Stevenson lifts the curtain on the craft of writing, from choice of words to his first book.

493.hook: Over a bad dinner by the Thames, sailors circle the story of a tug captain's terrible secret.

494.hook: An old captain waits daily for a son who left long ago, and his neighbour waits with him.

495.hook: A shipwrecked stranger washes ashore in an English village that fears him, and one woman who does not.

496.hook: A lame young prince, exiled to a lonely tower, receives a magical travelling cloak from his fairy godmother.

497.hook: A restless Victorian gentleman recalls kings, cork legs and a childhood he can barely reach.

498.hook: A bright, irrepressible girl is sent to live with stern aunts, and slowly wins over a whole small town.

499.hook: A magazine story about a buried golden idol sends young inventor Tom Swift into the Honduran jungle.
